queries: What is our total won deal value?
How much pipeline value have we closed this year?
Show me the total business we have booked so far — all time
expected_behavior: Returns the sum of all won deal values in TND, optionally filtered by month or year.

queries: Show me all our client companies
List all prospect companies
Which companies do we have in the IT industry?
expected_behavior: Returns a paginated table of companies filtered by status ('client', 'prospect', 'inactive') and/or industry keyword.

queries: Tell me about BNA BANK
What do we know about poulina group?
Show me the full profile for Tunisair
expected_behavior: Returns full company profile including industry, city, phone, email, open deal count, and contact count.

queries: Show me all open deals
What deals do we have with BNA BANK?
List won deals worth more than 30,000 TND
expected_behavior: Returns a deal table filtered by status, company name, and/or minimum TND value.

queries: Show me the Implementation ERP deal
What is the status of the Consulting transformation digitale deal?
Find the Migration base de donnees deal
expected_behavior: Returns full deal details (stage, value, probability, company, notes) by title keyword match — title is preferred over numeric ID to avoid extraction issues.
note: Use title parameter (string) not deal_id (int) in demo queries to avoid the ID extraction bug.

queries: Give me a pipeline overview
How are our deals distributed across statuses?
How many open versus won deals do we have and what are the total values?
expected_behavior: Returns deal counts and total TND values grouped by outcome status (open/won/lost/on_hold) — no individual deal records.

queries: Show me all our contacts
Who are the contacts at BNA BANK?
Find contact Ahmed in the CRM
expected_behavior: Returns contacts table with first name, last name, role, company, and email — filterable by company name or contact name.

queries: What activities are due this week?
Show me all pending activities for Tunisair
List all completed call activities
expected_behavior: Returns activities ordered by due date, filtered by due_this_week, completion status, or company name.

queries: Add a new prospect company called TechVision Sfax in the IT industry, based in Sfax
Register InnoSoft Tunis as a new prospect in Tunis, email contact@innosoft.tn
Create a new company: DataCore Bizerte, industry: Cloud Services, city: Bizerte
expected_behavior: Shows a preview of the new company record; creates it in the CRM only after the user confirms.

queries: Change BNA BANK's status to inactive
Update poulina group's phone number to +216 70 100 200
Set the website for UIB to www.uib.com.tn
expected_behavior: Agent first calls get_company to resolve the name to an integer ID, then previews the field changes; applies only after user confirmation.
safe_phrasing_note: Use company names (not raw numeric IDs) so the agent performs the two-step lookup internally.

queries: Add a new contact: Rania Mansouri, CTO at BNA BANK, email r.mansouri@bnabank.tn
Create a contact for Karim Ferchichi, IT Director at Tunisair, phone +216 50 111 222
Register Leila Saidi as a Project Manager at cyberpark elghazala
expected_behavior: Shows preview of the new contact linked to the named company; creates only after user confirms.

queries: Create a new deal for BNA BANK: ERP Migration Platform worth 120,000 TND
Open a new opportunity for BIAT — Digital Transformation Portal, 250,000 TND, qualification stage
Log a new deal for GlobalNet: Cloud Infrastructure Audit, 75,000 TND
expected_behavior: Shows deal preview (company, title, value, stage); agent looks up company by name internally and creates the deal on confirmation.

queries: List open deals for BNA BANK and mark the Consulting transformation digitale deal as won
The Implementation ERP deal for groupe khalfallah digital fell through — mark it as lost
Put the Consulting transformation digitale deal for BNA BANK on hold
expected_behavior: Agent calls list_deals or get_deal to resolve the deal name to an integer ID, then previews the status change; applies on confirmation.
safe_phrasing_note: Use deal title keywords instead of numeric IDs; the agent should call list_deals first to find the correct deal_id.

queries: Schedule a follow-up call with Tunisair for 2026-06-20, title: Contract Renewal Discussion
Log a meeting with BIAT on 2026-07-05 — Proposal Presentation for ERP Project
Create an email task for GlobalNet due 2026-06-10: send updated pricing proposal
expected_behavior: Shows activity preview with type, title, company, and due date; creates the activity only after user confirmation.

queries: Remove the TestCorp company from the CRM — it was a test entry
Delete the duplicate TestCorp prospect
expected_behavior: Agent calls get_company to resolve the name to an integer ID, then previews the soft-delete; marks is_deleted=True on confirmation (record is preserved in DB).
safe_phrasing_note: Always refer to the company by name; never ask the agent to delete a company by numeric ID directly from natural language.

queries: Remove the duplicate contact at topnet from our CRM
Delete the contact for Ahmed Benali — they've left the company
expected_behavior: Agent calls list_contacts to find the integer contact_id, then previews the soft-delete; applies on confirmation.
safe_phrasing_note: Refer to contacts by name and company; the agent must call list_contacts first to find the numeric ID.

queries: Delete the deal for Developpement tableau de bord at magasin mabrouk electronique — it's a test entry with a 23 TND value
Remove the Mise en place data warehouse deal for cafe carthage — value was entered as 42 TND
expected_behavior: Agent calls list_deals or get_deal to find the integer deal_id, then previews the soft-delete; applies on confirmation.
safe_phrasing_note: Use deal title and company name to identify the deal; never pass a raw deal_id from natural language.

queries: Update the email for contact Leila Khelifi at UIB to l.khelifi@uib.tn
Change the role of the first contact at CNAM to IT Director
expected_behavior: Agent calls list_contacts to find the integer contact_id, then previews field updates; applies on confirmation.
safe_phrasing_note: Reference contacts by name and company so the agent performs the list_contacts lookup before calling update_contact.

queries: Move the Implementation ERP deal for groupe khalfallah digital to the negotiation stage
Increase the value of the Consulting transformation digitale deal for BNA BANK to 55,000 TND
Set the probability on the Maintenance et support applicatif deal to 80%
expected_behavior: Agent calls get_deal or list_deals to find the integer deal_id, then previews field changes (stage, value, probability, notes); applies on confirmation.
safe_phrasing_note: Use deal title keywords so the agent can look up the deal_id without LLM integer extraction.

queries: Show me pending activities for Tunisair and mark the call activity as done
List activities for Banque de Tunisie and complete the pending call activity
Show me all pending email activities for GlobalNet and mark the renewal email as done
expected_behavior: Agent calls list_activities to display the activity ID in brackets (e.g. [3]), then previews completion; marks done=True on confirmation.
safe_phrasing_note: Always phrase as a two-step query (list first, then mark done) — the agent reads the bracketed ID from list_activities output rather than extracting it from user text.

queries: Which clients should I worry about losing?
Show me all companies with churn signals from the warehouse
Who are our most at-risk accounts right now?
expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list (up to 10) of companies with the most churn signals from warehouse.fact_activities, including signal count and last signal date.

queries: What is the churn risk for BNA BANK?
Is Tunisair at risk of churning?
Run a churn prediction for GlobalNet and give me the recommendations
expected_behavior: Runs ML churn model for the named company; returns probability, risk level (High/Medium/Low), top contributing factors, and retention recommendations.
note: SAFE — deterministic bypass extracts company name via regex without LLM integer extraction.

queries: What are the odds on deal 11?
Will we win deal 3?
Predict the outcome of deal 8
expected_behavior: Runs ML win/loss model for the specified deal ID; returns win probability, outcome label (Likely Win / Uncertain / Likely Loss), and top contributing factors.
note: SAFE — deterministic bypass in crm_specialist.py extracts deal_id via regex (\bdeal\s+(?:id\s+|#\s*)?(\d+)\b) before the LLM is invoked.

queries: Show me all invoices
List all overdue invoices
What invoices do we have for BNA BANK?
expected_behavior: Returns paginated invoice table with number, company, status, total, and due date — filterable by status and/or company name.

queries: Show me invoice JBM-2023-0008
Give me the full details of invoice JBM-2024-0034
What are the line items on invoice JBM-2024-0041?
expected_behavior: Returns full invoice detail including all line items, subtotal, TVA (19%), and grand total in TND.
note: SAFE — uses invoice_number string (e.g. 'JBM-2023-0008'), not integer invoice_id.

queries: What is our total revenue for all time?
How much did we collect in Q1 2025?
Show me the revenue summary for 2024
expected_behavior: Returns total collected revenue (paid invoices), pending amount (sent/draft), and overdue amount — optionally filtered by month, year, or quarter.

queries: Which invoices are past due?
Show me the top 5 most overdue invoices
Which clients are late on their payments?
expected_behavior: Returns overdue invoices sorted by most days past due, with invoice number, client, amount, due date, and days-overdue count.

queries: How much does BNA BANK owe us?
What is the outstanding balance for poulina group?
Show me the total unpaid amount for STE Khalfallah & Fils
expected_behavior: Returns unpaid invoice balance for the named client broken down by status (draft/sent/overdue), with total outstanding and oldest invoice date.

queries: Create an invoice for BNA BANK for 5 days of consulting at 8,000 TND per day
Bill BIAT for an ERP implementation — 1 delivery at 150,000 TND, due in 45 days
Generate an invoice for Tunisair: Conseil et assistance technique:3:12000, Formation utilisateurs:1:5000
expected_behavior: Parses items_description in 'description:quantity:unit_price' format, computes 19% TVA, shows invoice preview; creates draft invoice on confirmation.
note: items_description must use 'description:quantity:unit_price' format with comma separators and no commas inside numbers.

queries: Mark invoice JBM-2024-0041 as paid via bank transfer
The payment for JBM-2023-0008 just arrived — record it as paid by check
Invoice JBM-2024-0226 has been settled — mark it paid
expected_behavior: Shows payment preview with invoice number, amount, and method; records a Payment entry and sets invoice status to 'paid' on confirmation.
note: SAFE — uses invoice_number string not integer invoice_id.

queries: Mark invoice INV-0037 as sent to the client
Flag invoice INV-0046 as dispatched
Change the status of INV-0048 to sent
expected_behavior: Shows invoice summary before updating status from 'draft' to 'sent' on confirmation — does not send any actual email.

queries: Cancel invoice JBM-2023-0022
Void the overdue invoice JBM-2024-0226 for centre medical bouzid
Mark invoice JBM-2023-0341 as cancelled
expected_behavior: Shows invoice details before setting status to 'cancelled' on confirmation; rejects requests to cancel already-paid invoices.
note: SAFE — uses invoice_number string. Cannot cancel paid invoices.

queries: Extend the due date on invoice INV-0037 to 2026-08-01
Add a note to invoice INV-0046: client requested 45-day extension on payment terms
Push the deadline on INV-0048 back to 2026-09-15
expected_behavior: Shows the due_date or notes change before applying; rejects updates on paid or cancelled invoices.
note: SAFE — uses invoice_number string. Only due_date and notes are updatable; line item amounts cannot be changed.

queries: Look up invoice JBM-2023-0022 and then delete it — it was entered in error
Show me invoice INV-0037 and remove it from the system
expected_behavior: Agent calls get_invoice to retrieve the integer invoice_id, then previews the soft-delete; sets is_deleted=True on confirmation.
safe_phrasing_note: Always look up the invoice by number first (get_invoice); the agent reads the integer ID from the tool result rather than extracting it from user text.

queries: Generate a bar chart of total deal value by company from fact_deals
Create a line chart showing monthly revenue for 2024 from the fact_revenue table
Show a pie chart of activities broken down by type
expected_behavior: Queries the specified warehouse table, builds a Plotly trace with correct labels and TND formatting, saves the config to axis_charts, and returns the chart_id for display.
note: Valid chart_types: bar, line, scatter, pie, donut, funnel, area. Valid data_sources: fact_deals, fact_revenue, fact_activities, dim_client. Use x_truncation='month' or 'year' for date columns.

queries: What charts have we created so far?
Show me all saved charts
List all charts in the dashboard
expected_behavior: Returns all charts saved in the axis_charts table with their IDs, titles, types, and creation timestamps — optionally filtered by session_id.

queries: List all saved charts and then delete the oldest one
Show me my charts and remove the Revenue by Company bar chart
expected_behavior: Agent calls list_saved_charts to display integer chart_ids, then previews the deletion; permanently removes the record from axis_charts on confirmation.
safe_phrasing_note: Always phrase as a two-step query (list first, then delete by ID from the result); never ask the agent to delete a chart by a raw integer from user text alone.
